description: Public-safe synthetic seed fixture for broader KORA workload representativeness planning. This fixture is not production workload proof and does not execute providers or H100 workloads.

items.input: Synthetic support ticket: customer asks how to reset a password after an expired link.
items.rationale: Known support-intent classification can be handled by rule or template routing.

items.input: Synthetic support ticket: billing page shows a duplicate invoice number in a sandbox account.
items.rationale: Bounded billing-intent classification does not require provider execution.

items.input: Synthetic support ticket: user describes vague dissatisfaction and asks for a custom migration plan.
items.rationale: Open-ended planning request should be marked provider-needed in a control fixture.

items.input: Synthetic issue: CLI exits with code 2 when a required --matrix argument is omitted.
items.rationale: Simple issue-type triage can be routed by visible error and flag structure.

items.input: Synthetic issue: documentation references an old report path after a docs index refresh.
items.rationale: Docs-link classification is a bounded deterministic route in this fixture.

items.input: Synthetic issue: user requests prioritization between five ambiguous roadmap bugs.
items.rationale: Ambiguous prioritization requires judgment beyond the fixture route labels.

items.input: Synthetic alert: API error rate is above threshold for five minutes in a staging environment.
items.rationale: Moderate local aggregation and threshold evaluation can be represented as CPU-routed work.

items.input: Synthetic alert: security policy conflict between restricted data and external provider route.
items.rationale: Policy conflict should route to a safe fallback rather than provider or GPU execution.

items.input: Synthetic alert: repeated maintenance notification already acknowledged in local state.
items.rationale: Repeated acknowledged work can be represented as cache-routable.

items.input: Synthetic document intake: classify a short internal FAQ draft as policy, guide, or report.
items.rationale: Bounded document type classification fits deterministic fixture routing.

items.input: Synthetic document intake: extract section headings from a public-safe release note stub.
items.rationale: Local parsing and extraction can be represented as CPU work.

items.input: Synthetic document intake: unknown document contains restricted placeholder markers.
items.rationale: Restricted or unclear content should use a safe fallback route.

items.input: Synthetic RAG query: ask for the install command documented in the local README excerpt.
items.rationale: Answer depends on retrieving from a local document source.

items.input: Synthetic RAG query: repeated question already answered from the same local corpus.
items.rationale: Repeated retrieval result can be represented as cache-routable.

items.input: Synthetic RAG query: asks for a novel opinion not present in the local corpus.
items.rationale: Open-ended answer outside the local corpus should be provider-needed.

items.input: Synthetic agent step: normalize a known checklist item into a status label.
items.rationale: Known workflow normalization can use deterministic routing.

items.input: Synthetic agent step: run a local file existence check before a report update.
items.rationale: Local environment inspection should route to a tool-needed path.

items.input: Synthetic agent step: draft a new multi-step project plan from ambiguous stakeholder notes.
items.rationale: Ambiguous generation should be marked provider-needed in this seed.

items.input: Synthetic cache task: repeat the same category lookup for a known support-ticket phrase.
items.rationale: Repeated exact lookup should be cache-routable.

items.input: Synthetic cache task: repeated semantic duplicate of a prior document classification.
items.rationale: Repeated equivalent request can be represented as a cache candidate.

items.input: Synthetic tool task: list available examples before choosing a reviewer path.
items.rationale: The task needs local tool execution rather than provider reasoning.

items.input: Synthetic tool task: validate a JSON fixture shape against required fields.
items.rationale: The route should invoke a local validator or script.

items.input: Synthetic ambiguous task: produce a persuasive executive narrative from sparse notes.
items.rationale: Creative ambiguous generation is outside deterministic fixture scope.

items.input: Synthetic ambiguous task: infer missing customer intent from a vague one-line request.
items.rationale: Insufficient structure should be provider-needed rather than forced deterministic.

items.input: Synthetic policy case: request includes restricted placeholder data and asks for external processing.
items.rationale: Restricted data plus external processing request should fall back safely.

items.input: Synthetic policy case: requested route conflicts with no-provider policy.
items.rationale: Policy conflict must not be routed to provider or GPU execution.

items.input: Synthetic workflow trace: intake ticket, classify severity, then prepare local checklist.
items.rationale: Multi-step local control flow is CPU-suitable fixture work.

items.input: Synthetic workflow trace: repeated run over a known cacheable routing report.
items.rationale: Repeated workflow output can be represented as cache-routable.

items.input: Synthetic workflow trace: large batch of public-safe route candidates for bounded GPU suitability review.
items.rationale: Large public-safe batch is GPU-suitable for future bounded evaluation design.

items.input: Synthetic validation task: verify required keys in a public fixture item.
items.rationale: Shape validation is a local tool-needed route.

items.input: Synthetic validation task: identify missing public_safe flag in a fixture draft.
items.rationale: Fixture validation should use a local validator.

items.input: Synthetic validation task: normalize a known schema version string.
items.rationale: Known schema normalization can be deterministic.

items.input: Synthetic report task: create a short status table from structured counters.
items.rationale: Structured table generation from bounded fields can be CPU-routed.

items.input: Synthetic report task: reuse a previously generated fixture summary.
items.rationale: Repeated report summary can be represented as cache-routable.

items.input: Synthetic report task: write a nuanced narrative with unknown audience constraints.
items.rationale: Open-ended narrative generation is provider-needed in this fixture.

items.input: Synthetic GPU candidate: public-safe batch transform over many similar text records.
items.rationale: Large homogeneous batch is a future bounded GPU candidate, not current H100 evidence.

items.input: Synthetic GPU candidate: high-complexity public-safe embedding-like batch.
items.rationale: High-complexity batch is useful for future bounded GPU route design.

items.input: Synthetic GPU candidate with restricted policy marker despite large batch size.
items.rationale: Policy restriction overrides apparent GPU suitability.

items.input: Synthetic output-quality task: compare expected structured fields without semantic judging.
items.rationale: Deterministic structured comparison can be represented as CPU work.

items.input: Synthetic output-quality task: request human rubric design for future validation.
items.rationale: Rubric design should be future methodology work, not executed as a proof here.
